title: Count Common Words With One Occurrence
summary: Given two string arrays, words1 and words2, count how many strings occur exactly once in both arrays.
statement: Given two string arrays, words1 and words2, count how many strings occur exactly once in both arrays.
constraints: Count distinct words occurring exactly once in each array.
Repeated words in either array do not qualify.
hints: Exact multiplicity in both arrays requires two independent frequency maps.
Count each array, then inspect words from one map.
Add one only when first[word]==1 and second[word]==1.
Every common candidate is visited once, and the two equality checks encode the definition exactly.
